---
name: New provider
about: Request support for another agent tool
labels: provider
---

**Tool name and version**

**Where does it store session data?** (folder, file pattern, format: JSONL / JSON / SQLite / other)

**Does it log tool calls, sub-agents and token usage?** Describe the record *structure* (field names only, no message
content or secrets). A redacted 5-line sample is ideal.

**Can the tool write [Crew Events](../../docs/PROVIDERS.md#crew-events-integrate-any-tool) instead?** (hook, plugin, wrapper script)

**Willing to contribute the provider?** See CONTRIBUTING.md.
